Holly Elementary, Kindergarten to Grade 7 in School District 37 (Delta), is at 4625 62 Street, Delta, V4K 3L8.

The City's Ladner page says "East Ladner" is the common name for the part of Ladner east of Highway 17A. Highway 17A runs north-south from Highway 99 to the BC Ferries terminal, and Ladner Trunk Road is the main east-west artery.

Delta publishes no Holly boundary. The Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw No. 8400 page lists no planning areas or neighbourhoods, and the City's 2024 OCP fact sheet never mentions Holly, so Holly is not an official City of Delta planning area.
The City's parks map lists a Holly Park in Ladner, with no address given.
Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing rules cover lots zoned RS or RD "as well as some CD zones".
Delta allows one secondary suite per single detached dwelling; suites cannot be strata-titled or sold.
Elsewhere in Ladner, April 2026 permits include a duplex with two garden suites at 5042 59 Street.

blocks.text: Holly, Ladner: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Under Bill 44, Delta had to change its zoning before June 30, 2024. Council gave the amendments first to third readings on June 3, 2024, and cannot hold a public hearing on them.

Limits are three units on lots up to 280 m² and four units on lots over 280 m². Six units apply only within 400 m of frequent transit along Scott Road, which is in North Delta, so that tier does not reach Ladner.
Each unit needs one on-site parking space, except units under 33 m². Compliant projects skip rezoning and Council, but covenants on title, steep slopes and nearby streams can still limit a lot.
Council adopted the OCP on July 8, 2024.
Delta applies a Development Permit Area for Streamside Protection and Enhancement in some areas.

blocks.text: Holly, Ladner: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Highway 17A overpass at Highway 99 was struck by an over-height vehicle on July 18, 2023, and repaired from January 8, 2024.
During Highway 99 southbound closures, traffic is detoured via Highway 17A to Ladner Trunk Road, so Ladner streets carry through traffic on those nights.
West of Arthur Drive the road is 47A Avenue, which links Ladner with Tsawwassen.
Ladner Exchange is at 4645 Harvest Drive.

blocks.text: Holly, Ladner: development and new projects

items.t: 4739 and 4749 60B Street, Bassi Properties: 16 four-bedroom townhouses in two 3-storey buildings, rezoning to CDZ65. STATUS: 3rd Reading Conditions, feedback closed October 30, 2025, Council dates to be determined (check current).
Fraser River Tunnel Project: an eight-lane immersed tube tunnel replacing the George Massey Tunnel on Highway 99 between Richmond and Delta.
2026 property tax was due July 2, 2026, with a 2.9 percent City increase; penalties are 5 percent after July 2 and a further 5 percent after September 2.

Flat-rate utilities for a single-family home are $1,658 in 2026, up from $1,607. Metered water is $1.47 per m³ for the first 125 m³ and $1.97 above that. Sewer is $2.13 per m³ on 80 percent of water use, with $25 quarterly minimums.
Home Owner Grant: basic maximum $570, additional $275.
A new secondary suite requires a water meter, so the house moves to quarterly metered billing.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax lists the City of Delta as a taxable area.
Ladner Exchange serves routes 310, 601, 606, 608, 609, 616, 618, 620, 640 and 900 (map dated April 2025).
Route 601 (South Delta/Bridgeport Station) runs on Ladner Trunk Road and Highway 17A and calls at Massey Exchange on Highway 99 and Bridgeport Station, per the timetable effective January 1, 2024.
Highway 17A links Ladner to Highway 99 by road, and Ladner Trunk Road continues east as Highway 10.

blocks.text: Holly, Ladner: risks and due diligence

items.t: The 1894 flood is the design flood for the Fraser River dikes.

Delta's building permit guide requires the Minimum Building Elevation on the Geodetic Survey of Canada datum and geotechnical input for soft soil, and charges a covenant fee where sanitary or storm pumping is used.
Delta's three sloped-lands permit areas are ND1, ND10 and SD2; none is a Ladner area.
Check title for covenants and ask the City about stream proximity before relying on an addition or suite.
